points.text: The `wdb` MCP answers in fewer calls: `all=true` returns a whole lookup or check in one reply, `lookup reads=[...]` answers several reads at once, pages are about 60 lines, `names` lists every function, and a doc without a heading returns its outline with line numbers.

`slice.py open` gains `--seed-only`, `--in WT` (an existing worktree) and `--launch WT --review`; the gather agent now sees the User's request, is told to batch its reads, and stops only at a 30-round runaway cap.

The mechanical seed lists the scripts a job doc names (with their functions) instead of the whole system, the index can hold line ranges of files and docs, `adjust batch --op` works under the gather role, and the identity says `gather: agent` once the agent refined it.

Fixes from the second gather run: `adjust demote` and `set-condition` take their condition as text or `--when`, `adjust --help` lists every op, a failing op's error always prints in full (also with `--dry-run`, and in `--json`), `--verbose` exists, `find.py xref --path` accumulates repeated paths, `wdb_mcp.py call --help` lists each tool's arguments, a doc without a heading stays its outline even with `all=true`, and identical batched reads run once.

Report Bug on phones and tablets: tapping a text field now opens the on-screen keyboard in the web build, the Door and Job lists take two taps (the first picks a row and shows its description, the second closes the list) and scroll instead of covering the description, Email me about this report stays off and disabled until you type a valid email and then checks itself, and the privacy line now promises your data is never sold and is used only for debugging and messages you authorize.
The start card's ref and merge-back follow the checked-out branch; `check.py load-graph` no longer flags the slice's `session-context.md`.

Rough edges from the implementation run: `slice.py open` sets a new worktree up for Godot and shoots the slice's before shots before any edit (`shots.py flow --before`), and `check.py prove` says plainly whether a visual review is requested and which shots, names a missing setup, and groups signature and docstring REVIEW lines (310 to about 20 here); `find.py func` stops at the function end; `find.py xref` and the gather prompt cover `project.godot` and `export_presets.cfg`; `--scope`, `--history`, `--for` and `--paths` accumulate repeats; `--match` hits never fold; the script cap says 10000 bytes; Report Bug smoke failures name the failed step; Godot UI-check quirks are written down in debug-smokes.

entries.summary: The Report Bug page works on touch screens (keyboard, two-tap lists, email opt-in, privacy promise); behind the scenes, the slice gather and the repo MCP waste fewer turns and scope context more tightly.

points.text: New read-only repo MCP for Grok Build, `wdb` (`lookup`, `check`, `protocol`): thin wrappers over the existing find/check/docs/session tools that answer with a status and a short first page, keep the rest behind a handle (several sessions can share one checkout), and cap Build check reruns.

`slice.py open` now prepares the slice before Build starts: it runs `slice.py start` for the new session, lets a cheap gather agent refine the session plan, checks the result itself and writes `session-context.md`. A crash falls back to the plain seed with a loud warning; a halt or a failed check stops before launch. New `--review`, `--launch WT` and `--no-gather`.

`session-plan.md` is now a context index (core items and conditional candidates) changed only through the new `slice.py adjust`, which logs every change and is replayed by `plan --refresh`; the new `slice.py expand` builds or validates the packet. `find.py func --full` prints a whole declaration.
Build docs and skills point at the packet and the MCP instead of the manual trim; the live run with the real model is a separate step (task `build-gather-mcp`).

entries.summary: Behind-the-scenes Build tooling: slices open with their context already gathered and checked, and a repo MCP serves lookups in short pages, with no gameplay changes.

points.text: Unused-code cleanup across all scripts: the unused-code sweep now follows the ways the game actually reaches its code (string calls on loaded scripts, lazy-loaded helpers, schema keys read by name, shot-flow targets, skin lists, typed facades), so far fewer live functions are flagged by mistake. Flagged "maybe unused" rows dropped from about 750 to 140; the rest are shared or debug-only paths that stay as warnings on purpose.
Clearer types in playtest, debug menu, enemy AI, shop, pause/recap, music and light-stamp code (new `PlayHost`, `DebugMenu`, `EnemyHost`, `ProgressUI` class names) with no behavior change.

Verified-dead code removed: the orphaned pause inventory action and text scripts (`inv_act.gd`, `inv_text.gd`) and their dead helper chain, the unused archives `rebuild`, unused dummy-boss helpers, and stale facades, with their doc mentions.

Safer cleanup tooling: `lint.py unused` gains a per-chunk view (`--paths`, baselines, `--why` reach explanation), `--apply` removes exact stale doc references itself and records each pass, and visual-path deletions must pass a load check. New `check.py chunk-finish` runs a chunk's checks with one retry and prints the failing line.

Fixes and coverage: the nightly promo clip selftest passes again on ffmpeg 6.1; the archives docs/read screens are covered by a shot flow; fresh worktrees are told how to install the Godot AI addon from the Asset Library.

entries.summary: Behind-the-scenes cleanup — the unused-code sweep now understands how the game reaches its code, dead inventory and debug leftovers are removed, and new tooling makes future cleanups safer, with no gameplay changes.

points.text: GPU actor lighting and ground marks: actor sprites sample the shared light texture on the GPU at the feet (same origin/span/lod tap as the ground shader) and multiply the sticker by that value. CPU `LightRt.sample_xz` is removed from the actor hot path. Marks are near-black, low-alpha floor silhouettes whose sole positions and quad geometry are pre-baked in `actor_soles.json`. They live in a shared pool (starts at 6 nodes) that actors check out inside a light volume and return on exit. Hub uses one sun-driven mark; dungeon allows up to three (torches, crystals, campfires) with alpha split so they do not stack black. Static actors (dummy, vendor) no longer use `ActorLit`. Hub building shadows match their projected polygons again (hull-mask FINE_GAP band lowered from 200 to 165 so it no longer reads above the 0.75 inside cut and grows every shadow 0.1 m).

Mark-pool and script-size follow-through: reparent into the pool with `false` so a mark never reads a global transform after its actor leaves the tree. `actor_lit.gd` split under 10 KB (mark pool and tick into `actor_lit/lit_pool.gd` and `lit_tick.gd`).

Headless local-AI tuner and campaign: the loop no longer stalls before decide rows. On a headless display `wait_painted` yields one process frame instead of waiting for the never-emitted `frame_post_draw`. Decide-row counting deduplicates against the spool. A headless run produced 1924 new rows; the resulting policy scored 199/383 held-out and 22/383 on the scripted ladder. Campaign walker now paths to the living guardian, opens doors, and takes stairs after the guardian dies; one weapon worn per run with next-weapon selection by lowest performance; floor-5 clear stored per weapon. P6 smoke survives Loadout’s real dungeon entry under the same headless wait. Wander falls through when a guardian or stairs exist; interact press uses the chosen prop instead of the nearest pickup stealing it.

Consumables on the live stat path: food and potion stat bonuses (`bonus_id` / `bonus_amt` / duration) flow through `App.gear()` via `consumable_bonus()`. Timed food (while heal-over-time is active) and potion (while its timer runs) add to derived stats. HP bonuses refresh max HP on apply and expire; the move-speed cache also watches active consumables.

Dungeon geometry and map edges: `outline.gd` split (seal/gap into `outline_seal.gd`); `mesh_span.gd` split (joins into `mesh_span_join.gd`, bevels into `mesh_span_bevel.gd`). Straight-span edge marking shared between `outline_seal` and `map_rim` via `edge_mark.gd`. Fixed-expectation edge/seal/rim fixtures added (`perf.py map --fixtures`). `Dungeon.walls` chain and the `torch_ms` metric removed (torch facing is assigned once at placement).

Debug surfaces and tools: `debug.playtest` split into `playtest` (AI sim walker / recommended config) and `bench` (hub/dungeon/perf-sweep). Report Bug UI files and shared helpers named in the UI docs. Inventory gains its own code-map row. Routes bind the wall pipeline and the light_rt shared write. `lint.py unused` gained a multi-line string lexer, inner-class scopes, file/module-aware dead-code graph, verified `--apply`, and refuses property-block vars; verified-unused code removed from visual-review paths; nightly advisory unused sweep added. `review_hook --nope` fixed; perf_sweep hub claim corrected.

Process, docs, and parked work: compact stops named “safe” (before Prove or a follow-up Gather/Change). `find.py changed --prior-week` lists seed-to-seed diffs. Build pickup starts at `slice.py start` + pc-offload. AGENTS.md brought under its 3350-byte boot budget. Contradictions, dated lines, and read_when drift cleaned. `shot-catalog-gaps` task closed. Unfinished female modular-voxel mannequin (build script, cells, blend, keyed parts, review shots) saved under `_src/wip/modular-voxel-walk/` for next week.

entries.summary: Grok Build Week 11 — GPU actor lighting and shared mark pool, headless AI tuner and campaign unblocked, consumable bonuses on the live stat path, dungeon/map edge and wall-pipeline cleanup with script splits under 10 KB, playtest/bench split, lint unused-code improvements, and the unfinished female voxel mannequin parked for next week.
